ns2:section.sectionText: Course is for Information Science majors providing a more in-depth exploration, engagement, and development within the iSchool. Always restricted to declared Information Sciences Majors (if you plan on transferring into the major and are interested in this course, please email bsis-advising@illinois.edu). May be repeated (limit of 3 experiential hours count towards IS electives). For more information about this major, please visit: http://go.ischool.illinois.edu/BSIS. Questions may be sent to bsis-advising@illinois.edu.
